tourist.heroDescription: Discover real stories and directly support Wayna entrepreneurs with a transparent donation.
tourist.donateQuestion: How much would you like to donate?
tourist.secureSupportDescription: Your donation will be registered and linked directly to the entrepreneur’s goal.
tourist.thankYou: Thank you for your support. Your donation is being processed.

confirmation.title: Your contribution was registered
confirmation.intro: Follow these steps to complete payment.
confirmation.successFallback: Donation registered. Use the QR code to continue.
confirmation.emptyTitle: We couldn’t find a recent donation
confirmation.emptyBody: You may have opened this page directly, or the session may have expired.
confirmation.qrAlt: QR code to complete your Wayna payment
confirmation.helpDigital: Scan this code with your phone camera. In the Wayna MVP it encodes your donation details; later it may link to your banking app.
confirmation.helpCash: Show this code at the Wayna desk or to the cashier so they can confirm your cash payment.

profile.storyFallback: This entrepreneur is part of Wayna and seeks to grow with direct support from tourists and visitors.
profile.noCampaignBody: To receive donations from this page, an administrator must create a campaign with status "active" for this entrepreneur. The goal shown above may be informational only until that campaign exists.

donationForm.chooseSubtitle: Pick an amount in bolivianos and confirm your support.
donationForm.noActiveCampaign: This entrepreneur does not have an active campaign yet.
donationForm.pendingNote: Your contribution will be registered as pending until it is confirmed.

traceability.title: Traceability
traceability.intro: Transaction records with UUID. Filter by status, origin, and dates.
traceability.emptyRows: No transactions match the current filters.
